In a survival scenario, it is important to have reliable and cost-effective communication methods, especially if you are off grid and not connected to the main power grid. Here are a few options for cheap off-grid communication in a survival scenario:

1. Ham radio: Ham radio is a popular option for off-grid communication, as it uses radio waves to transmit messages and does not require an internet connection. It is relatively cheap and easy to set up, and can be used to communicate with other ham radio operators within range.
2. Satellite phone: A satellite phone is another option for off-grid communication, as it uses satellite technology to connect to the internet and make phone calls. While it can be more expensive than other options, it is often the only reliable method of communication in remote or off-grid areas.
3. Two-way radio: A two-way radio, such as a walkie-talkie, can be a cheap and effective method of communication in a survival scenario. They are easy to use and do not require an internet connection.
4. Smoke signals: While this method may not be practical in all scenarios, it can be a simple and effective way to communicate in a survival situation. By creating smoke signals, you can alert others to your location and send simple messages.
5. Semaphore: Semaphore is a system of using flags or other visual signals to communicate messages over a distance. It can be a simple and effective method of communication in a survival scenario, especially in areas where noise or other distractions may make other forms of communication difficult.
